notes.method: Curves, grid lines and eta/Ny lines were extracted from the vector paths of the catalog PDF (not from pixels); axes calibrated locally on labeled grid lines. Quadratics: P[Pa] = a*Q^2 + b*Q + c, Q in thousand m3/h, Pv = full pressure.
notes.qRangeGraph: Actual extent of the bold n=const curve on the graph (thousand m3/h). The catalog table rounds ranges (1.20-2.60, 1.80-4.20, 3.70-8.50/9.00); do not extrapolate the quadratic beyond qRangeGraph.
notes.etaSamples: Crossings of the n=const curve with the constant-efficiency lines (straight lines of slope 2 in log-log). eta label order matches lines sorted left to right by upper end.
notes.powerSamples: Ny arcs (blue) do not cross the n=const curves on these graphs, so kw is SHAFT power derived at each eta crossing: kw = Q*1000*P/(3.6e6*eta). Installed motor power Ny (blue arc value) = shaft power * K; see the task report for the K check.
notes.pdvAxis: Pdv = coeffC * Q_thousand^2, coeffC = geometric mean over the labeled Pdv ticks of the graph (20,30,50,100,200 + 300,800 or 500 Pa depending on the graph).

pdvCoeffOverride.note: Pdv scale is printed shifted ~20 px left relative to the Q scale on these two graphs (all six labeled marks uniformly, measured C ~9.0). Pdv depends only on Q and the outlet area, so C is the same for all diameters; coeffC is the mean of the consistent graphs D=0.9, 0.95, 1.0.
